identification: Modern novelty pendant light: large clear glass sphere (about 30-35cm) filled with tangled loops of aluminium/silver wire, suspended on steel cables from a brushed stainless steel dome canopy with driver box; a bag of fittings included. No brand or maker mark visible. Looks like a contemporary decorative 'wire tangle in glass globe' pendant, similar to Italian-style or budget Australian lighting retail.
